facts.fact: StackAdapt was named one of Quartz's Best Companies for Remote Workers in the 2023 list, which the press release describes as StackAdapt ranking #3.
facts.quote: StackAdapt ranks #3 on 2023 Quartz’s Best Companies for Remote Workers

facts.fact: In the Quartz Best Companies for Remote Workers evaluation, the workplace policies and practices portion was worth approximately 25% of the total evaluation.
facts.quote: This part of the process was worth approximately 25% of the total evaluation.

facts.fact: In the Quartz Best Companies for Remote Workers evaluation, the employee survey portion was worth approximately 75% of the total evaluation.
facts.quote: This part of the process was worth approximately 75% of the total evaluation.

facts.fact: The 2023 Quartz Best Companies for Remote Workers list was described as the third annual edition of the list.
facts.quote: Our third annual list of the Best Companies for Remote Workers

facts.fact: To be eligible for the Great Place to Work 2023 Best Workplaces in Professional Development list, organizations must be Great Place to Work Certified and have exceptionally high scores from employees on the Trust Index survey.
facts.quote: To be eligible for this list, organizations must be Great Place to Work Certified™ and have exceptionally high scores from employees on the Trust Index survey.

facts.fact: StackAdapt was named on the 2023 Best Workplaces in Professional Development list by Great Place to Work.
facts.quote: our organization has been named on the 2023 Best Workplaces in Professional Development
